protocol: Primary independent image-level mirror test=400 segmentation. Fit HCL+SkillOpt with all 800 train+val images; nested 80 feedback control, same four-family rule and .002 cut, same segmentation tools (120 train). Obtain out-of-fold tool predictions for those 120 via 5 folds; all others use fixed tools; same control. Secondary distinct fit=640 excluding all historical 160 diagnostic images. Paired error, Dice, review cost and diagnosis gains/losses, sensitivity and specificity. No post-test selection. All train labels/ground truths only in paired feedback. Diagnosis unknown for val/test. Each tool call budget 2 per image. Numeric potential outcomes shared.
